method: Read the native lab components, pure models, integration gate, and exact unit teaching models.

Ran the four pure-model tests, including the bounded exhaustive grid of all 1,201 signed offsets by 121 uncertainty values (145,321 legal numeric pairs), checking axis bounds and event-interval invariants alongside deterministic selection, denominator conservation, outcome precedence, overlap/touching behavior, unknown offset, and invalid input.
Inspected the live desktop development route for the D6 sampling pre-prediction gate and revealed exploration view.
Inspected true 320-pixel mobile captures for both native labs.

sampling: The human frame is exactly 240 accounts split 80 cloud, 80 server, and 80 database; the reproducible sample is 24 split 8/8/8.
The 18 service and 7 break-glass accounts remain outside the human denominator and receive separate full-test summaries.
Evidence begins missing, a pass requires all five applicable checks, and precedence is failure, exception, missing, then pass.
The UI explicitly states that the remaining 216 humans are uninferred and that learner-entered observations are not an executed security test.
timeline: Offset is defined as device clock minus reference and correction as raw minus signed offset.
The worked values produce IdP [09:59:58,10:00:02], database [10:00:18,10:00:22], and egress [10:00:38,10:00:42].
Precedence requires strict nonoverlap; touching and overlapping intervals do not fabricate order.
Unknown database offset withdraws database precedence while preserving only supported evidence and rejects intent, causality, completeness, or custody claims.
acceptance.predictionGate: Worked view exposes only neutral case entities before prediction. Opening native controls is an explicit learner action labeled 'Explore inputs · reveal outcomes'; continuing without an answer records no practice evidence.
acceptance.responsive: Both 320-pixel captures retain readable headings, labels, values, and minimum-size controls. The wide UTC plot is explicitly horizontally scrollable and has an exact table equivalent.

tests.result: 4 passed, 0 failed; 145,321 legal offset/uncertainty pairs exhaustively checked in the bounded grid

screens.observed: pre-prediction facts-only gate and revealed sampling exploration
